data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

The fund's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in AVBH, USCB, and FCBM.

On September 18, 2026, FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
